what: Ben's Fusion check F5 with Combine and a square pocket (a round one is curved, refused until 37/38a): a 60 × 40 × 20 block, a 20 × 20 pocket 10 deep cut by Combine, a sketch on the pocket's floor, then the pocket made wider (20 → 26, floor at the same height). No warning; the floor sketch keeps its face and plane (34a rule 2: only the floor's outline changed). No face of the tool lies in a plane of the target's (35b refuses faces lying on each other until 36a), which is why the parts sit off the origin planes as they do.

recipe.do: Start a new part and delete its ready-made box (feature-1) from the timeline, as the L bracket's make does, so the counter goes on from 2.
Create Sketch on the front plane XZ (sketch x is X, sketch y is Z, its normal −Y).
Extrude the sketch 40, not flipped (along −Y, y 0 to −40): Body 1, the block x 0..60, y −40..0, z −10..10.
Create Sketch on the top plane XY (inside the block: z = 0 is its middle).
Extrude the sketch 15 (z 0 to 15): Body 2, the pocket tool, its bottom z = 0 inside the block and its top above the block's top z = 10.
Combine: target Body 1, tool Body 2, Cut, Keep tools off: a 20 × 20 pocket 10 deep, its floor the tool's start cap at z = 0.
Create Sketch on the pocket's floor (pick the face at z = 0, facing up).
Edit sketch-12: move point 13 from (20, −30) to (17, −33).
Move point 18 from (20, −10) to (17, −7), and finish the sketch: the pocket is now 26 × 26 round the same centre (30, −20), the floor still at z = 0.

volume.why: the block 48000 less the widened pocket 26 × 26 × 10 = 6760: 41240

area.why: the block's 8800; the pocket takes 26 × 26 off the top and gives it back as the floor, and adds four walls 26 × 10: 8800 + 1040 = 9840

topology.why: the block's 6 faces (the top now a ring) + 4 walls + the floor; edges 12 + 4 round the rim + 4 down the corners + 4 round the floor; vertices 8 + 4 at the rim + 4 at the floor. Euler–Poincaré with 12 loops (the top has two): V − E + F − (L − F) = 16 − 24 + 11 − 1 = 2 = 2(S − G), one shell, no hole through

box.why: the block's: the pocket opens on the top inside it

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): every crossing here is between planes at round numbers, exact, so no intersection measures past LINEAR and nothing may grow (B0 decision 5)

plane.why: the floor is the tool's start cap (role start) on the XY plane, z = 0; as a face of the result it bounds the material below it, so it faces up, +Z. 34a rule 2: it keeps the tool face's name and the sketch keeps its plane while only its outline grows (Fusion F5: no warning)
